text:
maria_cs: @sara_novaterra quick capture from our kickoff — Novaterra is asking to onboard a custom NLU model for loan application triage. They want PHI-safe handling, HSM key management, and a short safety/eval runway (2 weeks).

sara_novaterra: thanks Maria — yes correct. model is a finetuned 13B called loan-triage-13b-v1, trained on customer support transcripts + redacted docs. we need A/B with current ruleset, and must prevent leaking account numbers.

devin_se: copying notes — two immediate asks: (1) private deployment behind VPC with KMS+HSM; (2) deterministic eval harness for reranking + safety tests. can we scope compute? budget low so likely 1–2 gpus dedicated to start.

raj_ml: For safety I want: entity redaction tests, prompt-injection adversarial sweep, and token leakage fuzzing. I can draft the eval harness — will need sample transcripts (redacted) + ~500 test cases. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching disabled for this private run to reduce cross-request affinity.

olivia_pm: Heads-up: renewal is coming in 10 months. This is a high-touch pilot; if onboarding goes smoothly we should push a reserved capacity proposal. Track success metrics: false positives/negatives on triage, avg latency under 250ms p95, and cost per 1k tokens.

maria_cs: next steps I propose: 1) Get data bundle from Novaterra (SFTP link) with redaction checklist, 2) infra ticket to eng-infra for Private VPC + HSM, 3) raj to own eval harness, 4) enable SE enablement session with Novaterra in two days. @devin_se can you schedule?

devin_se: on it — scheduling 30m with Novaterra for Thurs 10:30 PT. also adding eng-ml and infra leads.

sara_novaterra: we can share a redacted sample set tonight. also appreciate a quick checklist for legal about what counts as PHI.

raj_ml: attaching quick eval plan inline:```
- smoke tests: 200 holdout transcripts (balanced by intent)
- safety: 150 prompt-injection attempts + 200 PII/PHI probes
- leakage: secret-insertion tests (10k token-range)
- metrics: precision/recall per-intent, top1/top3 accuracy, hallucination rate
```

maria_cs: perfect. I'll post the SFTP creds to the shared workspace once we have them. tagging @deploy-bot for infra ticket creation.

deploy-bot: new ticket created: INFRA-8203 Private VPC + HSM onboarding for Novaterra (assignee: infra-oncall). ETA 5 business days. :robot_face:

devin_se: one more ask — we should gate the pilot on passing the safety suite with zero high-severity failures. if any critical leakage found, fallback is hosted isolated model with stricter prompt templates.

sara_novaterra: understood. we prefer a canary rollout if possible. thanks team! :thumbsup:

maria_cs: closing loop — i'll update the customer success playbook entry for Novaterra and flag potential renewal upsell if pilot meets the SLA targets. I'll post a follow-up summary after Thurs session.
